caption: Figure 11: IOC with notification by RTE After writing the data into the IOC internal queue buffer, the Rte_Call function uses an OS call to notify the receiver by activating the server TASK on the receiving core. This TASK is provided by the RTE. This TASK body is responsible for reading the data from the IOC buffer by calling IocReceive function and for forwarding the data to the server runnable. Depending on the return value of the IOC function, the IocReceive and server runnable calls might be repeated several times to empty the IOC internal queued buffer (if specified).
